column1: # The sweep behind LOOSE_MATCH_DISTANCE in brucellaid/mash.py: every public ENA Brucella read set that
# BrucellaID identifies, measured under the shipped k-mer copy threshold.
# The threshold is the 95th percentile of the MASH distance of calls that AGREE with the ENA submitter,
# taken to a round number: past it, the closest reference is further than a correctly identified library
# normally sits. Earlier versions of this file held a weighted 207-run sample, because the full sweep had
# not been re-run under the current threshold; it now holds every identified run, so the percentiles are
# the population's and carry no sampling error.
# submitted   the ENA submitter label, normalised to a binomial. "Brucella sp." names no species, so
#             neither a match nor a mismatch can be judged at species level
# agrees      whether the two match, by the sweep's own rule
# distance    MASH distance to the closest reference
# shared      min-hashes shared with it, of 1000
# Runs sharing fewer than 150 hashes are left out: no species is reported for them, so there is no call to
# calibrate on. scripts/recalibrate_loose_distance.py derives the threshold from this file.
